# Project instructions

- Use Java 25 and Maven.
- Keep Cucumber glue in `com.qvision.automation.stepdefinitions`.
- Model API actions as Screenplay tasks under `com.qvision.automation.tasks`.
- Model observable API results as Screenplay questions under `com.qvision.automation.questions`.
- Keep feature files in `src/test/resources/features` and runners in `com.qvision.automation.runners`.
- Use Serenity-managed Rest Assured interactions and assertions where practical.
